method: Independent script: re-reads all four JSON files from disk, recomputes VO phrase timing with its own estimator, scans only film-facing text (VO, captions, end card) for naming, money and integration terms.

checks.check: JSON parses
Company name is always NavisLabs (company field, reveal wordmark, end wordmark, end card, VO L07/L21)
checks.details: O05=NAVISLABS, O23=NAVISLABS, endA=NAVISLABS, L07='This is NavisLabs.', L21='NavisLabs. Your company’s intelligence — for your people, and your agents.'

checks.check: No scene calls the company 'Navis' (bare 'Navis' only as spoken product shorthand inside its act)
No film-facing text calls a product 'Navis-AI' / 'Navis AI'
checks.details: only as a code-repository name in evidence fields

checks.check: Navis Application names the human-facing product (S11 title, S11–S14)
Navis Developer names the developer/agent product (S06 title, S06–S10)
Every feature exists in the audit (pointers resolve; ids exist in the master)
Every claim has evidence, and every VO line maps to a declared claim
Every future feature is marked future and only appears in S16
Every unknown/unsupported feature or claim is excluded
Every recording dependency is mapped (R01, R03, R04 fallback, R05–R10, stills)
Every VO line maps to a visual (shots it plays over)
Every important VO phrase lands on its matching screen state (timing recomputed independently)
Every music section has timing and layers; sections are contiguous 0–100 s
Every SFX has timing (t and frame agree, inside the film)
No audio gaps: music plan covers every frame; every silence is declared and intentional
No scene timing changes
S01–S17 align exactly with the master (17 scenes, 0–3000 frames, shots tile each scene)
No $70M valuation claim without approval
checks.details: variant B stays BLOCKED; approvals.json absent

checks.check: No invented customers (no customer names, counts or logos in VO / captions)
No invented revenue
No invented ROI / savings / multipliers
No fake external integrations (only demonstrated/verified ones; none of the excluded names in VO or captions)
No fake product UI presented as real (every verified product shot uses a real recording or a still of one; conceptual shots use none)
No future functionality presented as shipped
No unsupported MCP/API/SDK/CLI claims (only verified items included; no availability wording)
VO total 180–200 words and matches the declared total
Source files unchanged (master and audit match the Devtool originals; blueprint unchanged)

warnings: L04 'inboxes' overlaps its screen state by only 0.18s (estimate) — align on the recorded VO

The Remotion build does not yet reflect this AV master: it still renders 'NAVIS' (S05/S17 wordmark, end card) and 'NAVIS AI' (S11 title), the blueprint's S10 panel order, a 'Navis' browser address pill, and music to 99.6 s. See render_requirements.code_follow_ups_before_any_render.
asset_requirements.json is stale (generated from the master: 41 assets with different ids); the blueprint manifest drives the code.

Founder sign-off pending: VO L07/L08/L14/L17/L21 edits, S05 product sublabels, WORK STATE RESTORED / SCOPED TO EACH KEY captions, legal timing, music end at 98.6 s; U02 recorded as decided by the owner of record — confirm with co-founders if required.
Open blocking items: U05 filming backend, U06 restored-block visibility (else R04 fallback), U07 vector logomark, U08 demo-name clearance, U01 category language; U03/U04 keep endings B/C blocked.
R06 (Marlow Health): the master does not seed Marlow's own data, so the isolation panel may only show an honest empty result.
Cursor targets and caption anchors are estimates (calibrated: false) until the footage exists; VO phrase timings are estimates until the founder's lines are recorded.

Agent runs / economics are excluded: tasks and runs are real (F06), but the console is local (F07) and economics is unknown with no real data (F16). ALT_C (R11) is the honest option if a run page is wanted.
Wordmark NAVISLABS at 120 px is ≈930 px wide — check optically against the logomark.
